work.headingAccent: From conversation to a measurable pilot.
work.s1Desc: Tell us how your business operates today: where time is lost, how customers reach you, and where the bottlenecks are.
work.s2Desc: The system evaluates operational facts to isolate specific nodes where AI will reduce overhead and increase response speed.
work.s3Desc: If AI is economically unjustified for your volume, we tell you immediately. No fabricated sales pitches or unneeded tools.
work.s4Desc: Matched solutions (chat assistant, voice operator, document automation, or ad optimization) strictly fit your requirements.
work.s5Desc: We define specific success metrics and a safe testing window on real data before any full-scale deployment.
work.s6Desc: Management receives clear reports on saved labor hours, improved response rates, and system stability.

faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting an AI diagnostic audit.
faq.q1: What is <brand></brand> and how does it differ from standard consulting?
faq.a1: aiAUDIT is an impartial AI diagnostic platform. We do not sell generic ideas; we analyze your actual workflows to determine where AI delivers measurable economic impact.
faq.q2: How long does the initial Quick Audit take?
faq.a2: The interactive chat audit takes 3 to 5 minutes. The system asks focused questions about your operations, volume, and current pain points.
faq.q3: What if my business does not need AI yet?
faq.a3: We will tell you directly with clear reasoning. If your current volume or unit economics do not justify automation, we will not recommend unneeded tools.
faq.q4: What data is required to run the audit?
faq.a4: High-level information about your company activities, customer communication channels, inquiry volume, and main bottlenecks is sufficient. Passwords or confidential financial records are not needed.
faq.a5: Every recommendation is directly derived from the operational facts you supply. We structure a small, bounded pilot measured against specific KPIs.
faq.q6: Which business functions can be audited?
faq.a6: The audit covers customer support (chats, calls), sales pipelines, marketing and ad spend, document processing, and internal operational routines.
faq.a7: Yes, the initial online diagnosis and recommendation summary are completely free with zero obligation.
faq.q8: What is Deep Audit and when is it required?
faq.a8: Deep Audit is an advanced analysis for mid-sized and enterprise companies evaluating integrations with CRM, ERP, and internal databases.
faq.a9: All diagnostic data is processed via secure encrypted protocols and is never used to train public models. NDAs are available upon request.
faq.a10: Before launching a pilot, we agree on measurable metrics: response time reduction, zero lost leads, saved employee hours, or increased conversion.
faq.a11: If the pilot proves economic value, we proceed to full deployment and ongoing support. If not, the engagement ends cleanly with no lock-in.
faq.q12: How do I start the audit?
faq.a12: Type your company activity and primary challenge into the input box above, and AI will begin the diagnostic dialogue immediately.
faq.q13: How long does it take to prepare a pilot?
faq.a13: A standard pilot roadmap and setup are ready within 48-72 hours following the audit.
faq.a14: You own 100% of the diagnostic report and recommendations.
